blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — Thirty former rebels, now referred to by the government as “friends rescued” from “former rebels,” have begun an 11-day deradicalization and capacity-building program under the Enhanced Comprehensive Local Integration Program (E-CLIP) in Misamis Oriental. The program, which started last week, aims to help former New People’s Army (NPA) rebels return to their communities and rebuild their lives through livelihood and other support programs. The initiative is being implemented through the coordinated efforts of the provincial government of Misamis Oriental, the Philippine National Police, and the Philippine Army.
